"Hehe. Despite my looks, Poyo-Poyo is one talented Intel, poyo!"

A mysterious monster with no allegiance to either faction, who travels all over Arcadia, selling information to inquiring minds. It shows up in front of Kazuha from time to time, and teases her with the possibility of knowing about her brother Shiki, but mostly acts aloof, making it difficult for anyone to know its true intentions.

It occasionally is seen with a serious face, as if determined to do something…No one knows its true identity, but rumor has it that it knows considerable secrets about the world of Arcadia. 

[From the [url=http://aksysgames.com/pcube/]official site[/url]]
